equity.level_reason: No social-position dimension appears; the only groups are national and state jurisdictions, and geography, clinical status and period are not social-position dimensions.

notes: The nowcasting correction and EpiNow2 R t estimation are the primary model procedures, classed as other; the trend-category cutpoints are classification, not procedures. No CIs or tests are reported, and the time-point and jurisdiction comparisons are descriptive. The R t 'not estimated' rule for fewer than 10 visits is an exclusion rule, not listed.
view_issues: The Results say the 11 states growing on May 10 are on the West Coast and in the Northeast, but the table lists Arizona, Colorado, Nevada, New Mexico and Wisconsin among them. The table note defines categories as 'R t >90%' etc., while the Methods define them as probabilities that R t >1.
